# IMatch.Ended event

Raised on the game's thread once the match is over and its last round's banner is gone, as the results begin: about 3 seconds after the last round's points, on each game at its own pace. The [`XpScreen`](./XpScreen.md) is open, with its lines not shown yet, so changes to them show from the start.

public event EventHandler<EventArgs>? Ended;
